mapper.select: select id, adminID, password, phoneNumber from admin
select id, adminID, password, phoneNumber from admin where id = #{id}
select id, adminID, password, phoneNumber from admin where adminID = #{adminID}
select id, adminID, password, phoneNumber from admin where phoneNumber = #{phoneNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into admin(adminID, password, phoneNumber) VALUES (#{adminID}, #{password}, #{phoneNumber})
mapper.update: update admin set password = #{password}, phoneNumber = #{phoneNumber} where id = #{id};
